findings.case_fact: ambulate 250 feet modified independent with front wheeled walker

findings.claim: The need for an interdisciplinary team approach was found by the independent expert.
findings.quote: requires an inpatient stay and an interdisciplinary team approach to the delivery of rehabilitation care
findings.case_fact: a multidisciplinary team approach, a coordinated program of care

findings.claim: Physician supervision was documented only generally (several physicians saw her). Whether a rehabilitation physician made 3 face-to-face visits per week is UNKNOWN from the facts, but the expert found the supervision requirement met.
findings.quote: the rehabilitation physician must conduct face-to-face visits with the patient at least 3 days per week throughout the patient’s stay in the IRF
findings.case_fact: The beneficiary was seen at the IRF by at least three physicians and was monitored daily by the nursing staff.

findings.claim: The beneficiary did not need to reach complete independence or her prior functional level for the claim to be covered.
findings.quote: because a patient could not be expected to return to his or her prior level of functioning.
